memories.content: Gustavo is a mid-tier sales rep at Brightline Software, selling invoice-automation software. He has a list of forty procurement leads at mid-market manufacturers in the Pacific Northwest. He plans to cold-email them this week. His usual booking rate is about one discovery call per sixty cold emails.

Gustavo has a list of forty procurement leads at mid-market manufacturers in the Pacific Northwest. He can send cold emails to these leads through standard email channels. The leads may or may not respond to such emails.
